_comment: Single source of truth for topics and their value schemas. Read by the init container (infra/init/init.py) and by tests. JSON has no comments, so PROD notes live in prod_note fields.

defaults.prod_note: PROD: replication.factor=3 and min.insync.replicas=2 with acks=all on a 3+ broker cluster.

topics.name: job-requisitions
topics.prod_note: Aggressive compaction settings are for the demo only. PROD: use defaults (dirty ratio 0.5, segment.ms 7d) or compact,delete with a long retention.

topics.name: candidate-applications
topics.prod_note: Contains PII. PROD: shorter retention, ACLs, encryption at rest.

topics.name: parsed-resumes
topics.prod_note: Same partition count as candidate-applications keeps job_id ordering end to end.

topics.name: parser-dlq
topics.prod_note: PROD: alert on any message here and keep retention long enough for a human to triage.

topics.name: matching-dlq
topics.prod_note: Added beyond the PRD: matching failures (LLM errors, schema issues) need a DLQ too.

topics.name: candidate-scores
topics.prod_note: Sunk to Postgres by Kafka Connect, so Kafka retention only needs to cover sink downtime.

topics.name: pii-audit-log
topics.prod_note: Holds raw PII for audit. 1 day retention in the demo. PROD: encrypt payloads, restrict ACLs, archive to a compliance store.

topics.name: job-stats
topics.prod_note: Output of the bytewax analytics job, latest value per job_id.

topics.name: connect-dlq
topics.prod_note: Kafka Connect error sink: records the JDBC sink could not write (bad schema, constraint violation). Raw bytes, so no value schema. PROD: alert on any message here.
